Ratio c_bg/c_tg=0.772765 and CNP intercept 0.051215 V from measured ridge. c_tg=0.002796059 F/m2 remains a geometry prior; D offset -0.013 V/nm is inferred from resistance minimum, not independently proven electrostatic zero. Use these as provisional coordinates and store actual gate trajectories. Two ridges suggest inhomogeneity but do not establish different stacking or a gap solely from resistance.

Electron n*=3.2: signed R -32.9..529.6 Ohm, spectral structure near 7.5/15/22.5/30 T, potentially harmonics; hole n*=-1.2: 5/12.5 T at B=2..10, window dependent. Both live, no clipping, no sustained nA leakage. Never rectify R before FFT; negative excursions and possible Hall mixing remain caveats. Existing spot theory numbers are not validated predictions and cannot establish stacking.
4. Landau fan — next. D*=0 line, n*=-1.2..3.2 in 0.04 units of 1e12 cm^-2 (111 points), Si=0, base T. B=0,1,1.5 baseline rows then 31 points uniform in 1/B from 2 to 5 T and 5.25..10 T in 0.25 T steps; 54 rows, 5994 points. Upward only from actual near-zero handoff. Preserve 3 s dwell (10 tau at 24 dB), sr1 sensitivity 100 uV (10 kOhm nominal), sr0 20 mV. Fields below 2 T are sparse context only; fine field spectra below 2 T already exist in runs 6/7. Subdominant high-frequency harmonics above 50 T not resolved in low-field fan; consult spot traces. Ramp floor 10*7.3=73 min; run 5 ordinary dt median 1.10 s at 1 s dwell -> ~0.10 s read/set overhead, allow 0.20 with added readbacks; 5994*3.2 s=320 min plus ~12 min row overhead and 15% margin -> 7h30m. Run 6/7 non-ramp overhead ~3.1 s includes driver settle. Baseline row checks survived handoff without repeating full Gate C.
   Check first points and first three rows, then every ~30 min and at crossing 2/4/6/8 T. Inspect monitor for clipping, phase jumps, current loss, leakage, temperature. Per-point guards stop before another field step on severe read anomalies, rail, or leakage. Magnet interruption does NOT stop a ramp: alert operator if interrupt happens during field motion; always re-read actual state. Partial data remains. Checkpoint interpretation: are gate-dependent Landau branches present? If absent by 4-6 T, assess quantitative contrast before spending remaining hours. Completed fan: raw maps first, measured-current R via resistance_grids, signed R and gate/field readbacks, then branch tracking/FFT over suitable windows. Fit lever arm only conditional on defensible degeneracy, test more than one assignment; do not calibrate by assuming the desired stacking.
5. Discrimination — conditional on fan. Compare branch number, crossings, density evolution, carrier asymmetry with ABAB (two bilayer-like sectors), ABCA (quartic low-energy sector), ABCB (mixed sectors), allowing harmonics and two CNP offsets. These are qualitative hypotheses; unvalidated exact frequencies or a D-dependent resistance alone are insufficient. If necessary propose one targeted D-offset return fan/cut, starting at existing B; no automatic long detours. Temperature test only if it resolves a named ambiguity; read rig thermometry facts first. If no distinct signature, calibrated cannot tell.
6. Verdict — final ana cell: B_1-B_2 verdict and strength, numbered run-cited evidence, limitations and overturning evidence. Other contacts n.c., no spatial verdict for inferred internal domains.
7. Closeout — ask return-to-initial as brief requires, then author/run field 0 (73 min from 10 T), gates 0 at committed pacing, heaters off and full readback; record in session_notes.
